tour.title: Welcome to Learn
tour.body: Methods and algorithm sets for 3x3 and 2x2, from your first solve to full PLL.

tour.title: Pick a puzzle
tour.body: Each puzzle starts with a beginner method, then the sets that make you faster.

tour.title: Every set, one click away
tour.body: The sidebar lists every set. Your progress in each one is saved as you mark cases learned.

tour.title: Learn, then drill
tour.body: Mark a case learned, then drill it in the Drill Lab until it's automatic.

greetings.line: Hi, I'm {name}! Open me any time for a tour of this page.

tips: Two-look OLL and PLL take about 16 algorithms and get most cubers under 30 seconds.
